name: Princess Hunting ~Maou-sama no Shuukakusai~
original_name: プリンセス・ハンティング～魔王様の収穫祭～
source:
The story starts when Shaddy, the third princess, investigates the ruins just to kill time. She finds something sealed up and opens it...

However, it is actually a devil king, who lost a battle against a soldier long time ago. The devil king soon does away with her guards and shags with Shaddy...

He now moves to conquer the world..

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
故事开始于三公主莎迪为了消磨时间而调查废墟的时候。她发现了一些被封印的东西并打开了它……

然而，这实际上是一位魔王，很久以前就与士兵战斗失败了。魔王很快就除掉了她的守卫，并与沙迪发生了关系……

他现在开始征服世界..

[来自工口游戏商店]
